records.region: Côte-Nord, Québec; eastern upper lake chain, Rivière Gravel, Lac Walker and Rivière aux Rochers to Port-Cartier.

The independent park-study map begins south of that opening. A complete whole-selected-system correspondence therefore cannot be asserted.

The lake connections, intermediate joins and actual coastal terminal are supported at ordinary corridor scale. The chosen initial connection is a remaining substantive geographic gap, not a demand for exact banks or present operations.
records.supported_name_scope: The receiving Rivière aux Rochers and its connected Gravel–Ulysse-Morin–Walker corridor are supported. Separate river and lake identities remain distinct. A completed representative identity for the entire selected system is withheld because the chosen opening connection remains unresolved.

records.region: Northwestern Alaska, Woolfe Fork–Ipewik River–Kukpuk River–Marryat Inlet corridor
records.geographic_disambiguation: Representative receiving-river/system identity for the selected connected Woolfe Fork–Ipewik–Kukpuk route. Distinct named upstream reaches and the inlet remain separate; Kukpuk River is not asserted as a scalar name of every selected position.
records.completion_scope: Five serially acquired original maps were visually inspected over the chosen opening, all 42 stored parts of the one selected mainstem fragment, named confluences, side-lake and wetland settings, delta and actual coastal terminal. Continuous source channels and labelled confluences support the ordinary representative corridor. Pronounced local bend cutoffs are retained as generalization limits; no exact watercourse is asserted along every modeled straight segment. There is no required through-lake, managed or glacial connector and no substantial unread source interval.
records.supported_name_scope: Woolfe Fork upper reach; Ipewik River following their mapped confluence; Kukpuk River following the lower mapped confluence to Marryat Inlet.

scope_limits: The formal registry identity, naming boundaries, Indigenous-name equivalences and Korean forms remain unverified.

The coarse pinned line markedly clips some upper and lower Ipewik bends and locally crosses their surrounding side-valley or wetland setting. The completed claim is the connected named corridor, not exact correspondence of each modeled segment to a present channel.

The northernmost Ipewik cutoff is not evidence for a separate direct cross-hill waterway or a selected Windy Lake passage; the independently mapped meandering Ipewik channel supplies the bounded route association.
The cartography does not establish why individual modeled offsets occur; no model-error, channel-change or omitted-channel explanation is asserted.
No exact natural source, current bank, active delta branch, shoreline position or tidal discharge is established.
The terminal is identified at the Kukpuk mouth–Marryat Inlet setting; the inlet and its coastal lakes do not inherit the river name.
The modeled 160.908km length is not a source measurement of Woolfe Fork, Ipewik River or Kukpuk River.

records.region: Southern California: San Gorgonio Pass, Coachella Valley and Salton Sea
records.material_pending_reason: The inspected cartography does not establish the selected southwestern rectangular-basin/Chino-side excursion from the Whitewater corridor or the selected lower road/pond-to-lakeshore transfer. The named river reaches, ordinary river-to-lake setting and Salton Sea interior terminal are supported, but those do not close the selected through-link gaps.
records.geographic_disambiguation: San Gorgonio River on the supported upper corridor; Whitewater River on the supported downstream named river corridor; Salton Sea as the receiving and terminal lake. Two selected through-connections remain unestablished. No completed representative identity is assigned to the entire synthetic route.
records.completion_scope: Four readable original bounded USGSTopo views cover the entire supplied selection. All 47 parts, opening, named joins, dry-wash and channelized reaches, engineered-basin/pond contexts, lake approach and actual terminal were considered. Two substantive through-connections remain unestablished, so geographic correspondence is incomplete and this is not a completed naming-scope hold. The long lake-interior continuation separately prevents treating every selected part as one natural river.
records.supported_name_scope: San Gorgonio River on the supported upper corridor; Whitewater River on the supported downstream named river corridor; Salton Sea as the receiving and terminal lake. Two selected through-connections remain unestablished. No completed representative identity is assigned to the entire synthetic route.

scope_limits: The official naming registry, formal name-transition points, Korean forms and any alternative lower-channel formal name were not verified.
A mapped dashed wash or straightened channel is not evidence of perennial flow, current discharge, facility operation or natural-river identity for the complete selection.
The maps do not establish whether the selected deviations result from coarse modeling, changed hydrographic vintages, omitted waterways or another cause; no cause is asserted.
The lake shoreline is a cartographic depiction rather than a current field observation. The selected lake-interior line is not a river channel.
Nearby ponds, basins, Coachella Canal and Colorado River Aqueduct cannot be used to infer managed transfers or repair model links.
The modeled 159.395 km value is not an official named-river length.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
